mods.name: Enderscape
mods.description: A mod focused on improving The End with new biomes, mobs, and other features.

releases.notes:
Warning

- Old worlds will encounter issues as Enderscape creates conflicts with biomes underneath y0 in The End

Additions

- Config: much of Enderscape can now be configured

- Corrupt Depths, a new biome that generates underneath the outer End Islands
- Barren Depths and Barren Skies now generate as default biomes underneath the End Islands and in the End Skies respectively
- Small Islands now generate in the skies of The End very rarely, allowing as a rest point for Elytra flight and something nice overhead

- Corrupt Mycelium and Corrupt Growth grow in the Corrupt Depths on the biome's ceilings
- - Corrupt Mycelium can be placed in any direction
- - Corrupt Mycelium can be paved into Corrupt Paths, which can also face any direction
- - Corrupt Mycelium can be fertilized with Bone Meal to spread onto nearby End Stone
- - Corrupt Growth can face any direction as long as it has appropriate ground to stand on
- - Corrupt Growth can be fertilized with Bone Meal to grow more of itself
- - Corrupt Growth can be planted in Flower Pots

- Blinklights are long, double-helix shaped vines that becomes a large bulb at it's end
- - Occasionally, the large bulb and the smaller bulbs on the vine's body will blink
- - - When the large bulb blinks, it will emit a strong Redstone signal
- - - Fully grown Blinklight bulbs can manually blink by a Player
- - Blinklights emit subtle spores that will float around for a small time
- - Blinklights can be planted in Flower Pots

- Blinklamps, a light source crafted from Blinklights and Shadow Quartz
- - Luminance will decrease depending on the strength of the Redstone signal received
- - - As an example, you could plant a Blinklight underneath it and it would darken when the Blinklight blinks

- Large Murushrooms, complete with a new Murushroom wood type
- - Fertilize murushrooms growing on ceilings or floors to grow them
- - Murushroom stems have dark colored bark with light blue colored wood

- Lightspeed and Transdimensional, new enchantments for the Mirror
- - Lightspeed increases the distance you can travel by furthering the distance you need to go before your cost increases
- - Transdimensional lets you travel between dimensions instantly at the cost of a full bar of energy
- - - When used with Lightspeed, the total cost can be reduced significantly
- - These enchantments can be found rarely in End Cities

- Veradite, a new stone generating throughout the entirety of the outer End
- - Veradite can be used a stone crafting material, making it perfect for recipes like Furnaces
- - Veradite can be made into Polished Veradite, Veradite Bricks, Chiseled Veradite and Veradite Pillars
- - Rubblemites also uncommonly spawn with a Veradite shell

- Celestial and Murushroom Bricks
- - Using Celestial Caps and Celestial Growth, you can create Celestial Bricks
- - Using Murushroom Caps and Corrupt Growth, you can create Celestial Bricks
- - Celestial and Murushroom Bricks can be crafted into Stairs, Slabs, and Walls

- New Background Music
- - Finality, a peaceful track which plays in Celestial Plains and Celestial Islands
- - Mutagen, a mysterious track which plays in Corrupt Depths
- - Obduracy, a long, barren, but perseverant track which plays in default End biomes

- New Advancements
- - "A Link Between Worlds", completed by teleporting to a different dimension with a Mirror with Transdimensional enchantment
- - "Not Quite Long Distance", completed by teleporting over 2000 meters with a Mirror within the same dimension
- - "The Highs and Lows", completed by bouncing on a Drifter while flying at high speeds
- - "Otherworldly Drip", completed by crafting a pair of Drift Leggings

- Enderscape has a new skybox
- - Subtle nebulas and stars will cover The End's sky
- - Nebula colors change depending on the player's biome

- Enderscape has new lighting for The End
- - Darker and with just a tinge more of green, exploring The End should be much moodier

...

mods.name: Enderscape
mods.description:
A mod that adds new content to The End dimension, such as biomes, mobs, ores, and more.
The focus is to add features that aren't unfitting for the vanilla game while enhancing the overall experience.

The focus is to add features that aren't unfitting for the vanilla game while enhancing the overall experience.

releases.notes:
Additions

- End Gateways now generate in Celestial Plains

Changes

- Links to source code and issue tracker have been updated
- Murushrooms now generate at all heights
- Shadow Quartz Ore now generates at all heights
- Void-facing Nebulite Ore now generates at all heights, but needs at least 16 opaque blocks above

Fixes

- Fixed scattered Shadow Quartz Ore features not generating inside End terrain properly
- Fixed server crash with Flanger Berry Vines referencing a null value
- Fixed void Nebulite Ore features not generating properly
